title: Skyrmion-Antiskyrmion pair creation by in-plane currents
verdict_detail: Core mechanism reproduced: (1) Sk-ASk pair carries net-zero topological charge (Q_pair=0, Sk=-1/ASk=+1); (2) in-plane current drives partners with opposite skyrmion-Hall deflection; (3) antiskyrmion annihilates via Gilbert damping while skyrmion survives -> net delta-Q = -1 (Q: 0 -> -1, t_annih~0.75). Partial only on (a) de-novo pair nucleation from a seeded fluctuation and (b) full current-driven unbinding of a bound pair in the minimal setup.
